## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation.

Example: It is currently difficult to locate specific rooms because the GeoJSON datasets do not include room names.

## Describe the solution you'd like

A clear and concise description of what you would like to happen.

Explain the proposed feature or improvement and how it should work.

## Proposed changes

Describe the changes you would like to see.

- [ ] New GeoJSON dataset or geographical layer
- [ ] Additional campus, building, or floor coverage
- [ ] Improvements to existing GeoJSON datasets
- [ ] New Geocore functionality
- [ ] New CLI command or option
- [ ] Database integration or improvements
- [ ] Documentation improvements
- [ ] Other

Which part of the project would this feature affect?
